key_insight: AlgoRAG shows that a domain-specialized RAG system can deliver correct, pedagogically useful explanations for abstract theoretical computer science topics like proofs, recurrences, and NP-completeness.
engineering_relevance: This work suggests RAG is a practical architecture for scalable, personalized tutoring in math-heavy CS education when paired with retrieval tuned for notation and proof structure.
method: Curated knowledge base from textbooks, 847 slides, 312 solved problems, 156 proof templates, and 89 worksheets
Notation-aware retrieval with mathematical entity recognition and pedagogical re-ranking
LLM generation evaluated on exam-style questions across core TCS topics
evidence_signal: On 179 curated questions, AlgoRAG achieved a 100% success rate with 38.0 s mean response time, plus ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.0963 and pedagogical quality of 0.7620.
watch_item: BLEU-4 is zero and the evaluation depends on surface-text overlap metrics that may understate mathematically equivalent reasoning or overstate instructional quality.
paper_title: AlgoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Theoretical Computer Science Education -- A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Algorithm Analysis and Complexity Theory
